title: Migrate every ownership consumer onto the policy layer (still a no-op)
commit_subject: S1-C-prep: migrate every ownership consumer onto the policy layer
problem: The collection points decide what ships and what the final audit consumes. They asked artifact_ownership() whether a path is registered, and that returns None for a path with no Stage owner - so once S1-B registers the 21 fallback paths as policy-only entries, iter_owned_artifacts() would skip them and both submission_bundle gates would still call them uncovered. Migrating AFTER S1-B would have been a behaviour change hidden inside a classification change; migrating now is reviewable as a no-op.

new_helpers.iter_policy_artifacts: policy-aware twin of iter_owned_artifacts; mirrors its walk and skip order exactly, membership decided by artifact_policy
new_helpers.policy_ownership_rule: the legacy routing rule behind a path, or None (also None for policy-only)

intentionally_not_migrated: factory_core/dirty.py:404 - frozen trust root; its bytes are hashed into classifier_contract_sha256
factory_core/dirty_classification.py:192 - deliberately mirrors the frozen classifier's branch order

reachability_finding.claim_graph.py: REACHABLE and gate-relevant: claim_binding_issues is called by factory_core/steps/validators.py:203 and scripts/judge_packet.py:957 - a validator path
reachability_finding.diagnostics_service.py: REACHABLE but read-only reporting: used by web/backend/project_api.py:25
reachability_finding.conclusion: neither could be skipped; the plan's original 'four consumers' would have missed both

latent_bug_fixed.what: it imported artifact_owner_stage from the FROZEN module (83 rules) instead of the current one (88 rules), so the Web diagnostics payload disagreed with the rest of the system
latent_bug_fixed.fix: resolve through artifact_policy_owner_stage; a test asserts both the corrected values and that the frozen lookup genuinely differed (so the test cannot go vacuous)

equivalence_evidence.result: all 15 combinations set-identical between iter_owned_artifacts and iter_policy_artifacts
equivalence_evidence.note: B and R are symlinks resolving outside the repo; both iterators resolve the project dir internally, so the comparison must resolve too (a script bug caught during this stage, not a code bug)

source_level_guard: the last test scans factory_core/apps/scripts/web for calls to the four legacy lookups and fails unless the name is bound by an import from artifact_policy; only the two intentionally-unchanged modules are allowlisted
next_stage: S1-D (extend the provenance source mapping to policy semantics; CI invariant #4 hash extension already landed in 0.7.2; replay regression)
